{{Quote|This can't be happening!|Overseer Juhm, as the bombers destroy his shipyards|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
The '''Battle of Gwori''' was a battle during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in which [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had to pinpoint the location of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] shipyard on [[Gwori]]. Once there he had to call on a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|bomber]] strike to destroy it. However, his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] snuck aboard the mission when she wasn't supposed to. Together, and with help from [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], they not only had the bombers destroy the shipyards, but they freed a number of experienced [[Starship/Legends|ship]] builders.

==Prelude==
After [[Battle of Nexus Ortai|suffering a major defeat]] at [[Nexus Ortai/Legends|Nexus Ortai]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] decided to attack the shipyards at [[Gwori]], under the command of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] overseer, Juhm. However, the planet was protected by a blockade of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had also developed a machine that scanned all ships and eradicated any biological lifeforms on-board, meaning only droids could pass through harmlessly. To get around this, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] proposed that he, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and a small squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] freeze themselves in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in order to bypass the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] blockade and survive the eradication beam, as they would not register as life-forms on the droids' scanners. Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech unit]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], would pilot a transport ship containing the frozen team. Against Skywalker's instructions his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] also had herself frozen in carbonite to join him on the mission. Once there, Anakin and the attack group would deliver the shipyard coordinates to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] so they could lead a bombing run on the shipyards.

==The battle==
{{Quote|What is happening?|Juhm, just moments before the shipyards collapsed|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
Upon arriving at [[Gwori]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] piloted the [[Freighter/Legends|Freighter]] [[VX-391]], via a hacked [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] and joined a convoy of other transport ships approaching the shipyards. Using the battle droid as a puppet to communicate with the scanning gate, R2 successfully piloted the ship through. Unfortunately at that moment [[Juhm]] contacted the scanning gate about an irregularity in the convoy. The droids had just assumed that they extra ship was just a miscount by a [[PLNK-series power droid/Legends|Plunk Droid]], despite being warned of a Jedi attack. The droids suggested destroying all of the freighters as they could not identify which ship was the extra one. However this would cost too much and instead all the transport ships were ordered to change course to platform A-61, which all of the freighters did, expect R2-D2's as he did not know the way. Soon the freighter was attacked by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droids]], luckily R2 was able to eject the frozen clones and Jedi and escape himself before the ship was destroyed.

In order to bypass the Separatist blockade, the 2 Jedi masters and the Republic [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|bombers]] would have to perform a [[Precision hyperspace jump]]. Little did they know that the shipyards were full of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. In the meantime, Skywalker, Kenobi, Tano, and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were captured. However, with the help of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], they escaped. Once the bombers arrived, the Jedi decided to escape on a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Separatist frigate]]. However, the bombs took out their shields. Moments after Skywalker led the [[Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate (Gwori)|stolen frigate]] away from the shipyards, Tiin was about to blast it until Kenobi contacted him and told him not to. Plo Koon then ordered the bombers to strike the construction supports. Once they were done, the shipyards collapsed.

The stolen frigate reached the blockade, but it was too big for an immediate hyperspace jump, and it was unable to fight its way out because it hadn't been fitted with armaments when it was stolen. Because their shields were disabled, Skywalker and Kenobi couldn't risk attracting the attention of the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] that were patrolling the area, and they had to obey the orders of the traffic controllers. The frigate was directed into the scanning station, but Juhm found out where it was and ordered the station to activate the radiation beam. However, Koon and Tiin opened fire on the station, putting the beam out of action. The frigate accelerated through just before the station exploded.

==Aftermath==
The Jedi had escaped, the shipyards were destroyed, and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] ordered [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to kill [[Overseer/Legends|Overseeer]] [[Juhm]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] said that it was no major loss however. Back on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had once again been impressed by Anakin's work. The ex-slaves now could build warships with fair pay and happiness.

==Behind the scenes==
Note that Rex's armor lost its blue touch as Juhm tries to kill him and Ahsoka
